unit_cn: Unit 5 Working the Land 耕耘土地
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 5 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、农业/袁隆平/杂交水稻/有机农业/粮食安全主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.meaning_cn: 杂交植(动)物;杂种;混合动力车
words.example_en: Yuan Longping developed a new kind of hybrid rice.
words.example_cn: 袁隆平培育出了一种新型杂交水稻。

words.meaning_cn: 产量;产出;出产(作物);屈服
words.example_en: The new strain of rice gives a much higher yield.
words.example_cn: 这种新品种水稻的产量高得多。

words.example_en: Every grain of rice is the result of hard work.
words.example_cn: 每一粒米都是辛勤劳动的成果。

words.example_en: Healthy crops need rich and clean soil.
words.example_cn: 健康的庄稼需要肥沃而洁净的土壤。

words.example_en: Farmers grow different crops in the same field each year.
words.example_cn: 农民每年在同一块地里种不同的作物。

words.example_en: Hybrid rice has helped farmers expand their output greatly.
words.example_cn: 杂交水稻帮助农民大大提高了产量。

words.meaning_cn: 使增长;使兴旺;增长;激励
words.example_en: Farmers needed to boost yields in the fields they already had.
words.example_cn: 农民需要在现有的田地里提高产量。

words.example_en: This hybrid enabled farmers to expand their output.
words.example_cn: 这种杂交品种使农民得以扩大产量。

words.meaning_cn: 解决(难题);应付(局面);处理
words.example_en: He chose to study agriculture to tackle the food crisis.
words.example_cn: 他选择学习农业,以解决粮食危机。

words.example_en: A serious food crisis worried farmers across the country.
words.example_cn: 一场严重的粮食危机让全国的农民忧心忡忡。

words.example_en: Many farmers once faced a serious shortage of food.
words.example_cn: 许多农民曾面临严重的食物短缺。

words.example_en: Through intense effort he overcame many technical difficulties.
words.example_cn: 通过艰苦努力,他克服了许多技术难题。

words.example_en: Only through intense effort did he succeed at last.
words.example_cn: 只有通过强烈的努力,他最终才成功。

words.meaning_cn: 把……献(给);把……专用于;专心于
words.example_en: He devoted his whole life to the farmers of China.
words.example_cn: 他把自己的一生都献给了中国的农民。

words.example_en: Yuan was convinced that the answer lay in hybrid rice.
words.example_cn: 袁隆平确信答案就在杂交水稻之中。

words.example_en: It is estimated that most of the rice grown comes from his strains.
words.example_cn: 据估计,所种植的大部分水稻都来自他的品种。

words.example_en: His hybrid strains help to generate much more food.
words.example_cn: 他的杂交品种有助于产出更多的粮食。

words.meaning_cn: 本国的;国内的;家用的;家庭的
words.example_en: Much of China's domestic rice comes from hybrid strains.
words.example_cn: 中国国内的许多大米来自杂交品种。

words.example_en: Rice consumption is very high in many Asian countries.
words.example_cn: 在许多亚洲国家,大米消费量非常高。

words.example_en: Hybrids usually attain a higher yield than conventional crops.
words.example_cn: 杂交品种的产量通常比常规作物更高。

words.example_en: One characteristic of hybrids is their higher yield.
words.example_cn: 杂交品种的一个特点是产量更高。

words.example_en: Rice is a self-pollinating plant, which made his work harder.
words.example_cn: 水稻是自花授粉植物,这让他的工作更难。

words.example_en: Many vegetables put down deep roots into the soil.
words.example_cn: 许多蔬菜会把根深深扎进土壤。

words.example_en: One year a farmer may grow wheat, and beans the next.
words.example_cn: 农民可能一年种小麦,第二年种豆子。

words.meaning_cn: 有机的;不使用化肥的;有机物的
words.example_en: Organic farming is simply farming without using any chemicals.
words.example_cn: 有机农业就是不使用任何化学品的耕作方式。

words.meaning_cn: 化学制品;化学品;化学的
words.example_en: These chemicals can stay in the soil for a long time.
words.example_cn: 这些化学品会在土壤中残留很长时间。

words.example_en: Some pesticides can harm both the land and people's health.
words.example_cn: 有些杀虫剂会损害土地和人们的健康。

words.example_en: Organic farmers use animal waste as natural fertiliser.
words.example_cn: 有机农民用动物粪便作天然肥料。

words.example_en: Crops grown too fast are often poor in nutrition.
words.example_cn: 长得太快的作物往往营养不足。

words.example_en: Many people prefer fresh and nutritious food.
words.example_cn: 许多人喜欢新鲜而有营养的食物。

words.example_en: Organic methods keep the soil rich in minerals.
words.example_cn: 有机方法使土壤富含矿物质。

words.meaning_cn: 完全必要的;极其重要的
words.example_en: Clean water and rich soil are essential to farming.
words.example_cn: 洁净的水和肥沃的土壤对耕作极其重要。

words.example_en: Crops grown with chemicals often have less flavour.
words.example_cn: 用化肥种出的作物往往味道更淡。

words.example_en: Seawater rice can grow even on salty land.
words.example_cn: 海水稻甚至能在含盐的土地上生长。

words.example_en: Chemicals can stay in the crops that animals and people digest.
words.example_cn: 化学品会残留在动物和人类消化的作物里。

words.example_en: More food can help millions of people escape poverty.
words.example_cn: 更多的粮食能帮助数百万人摆脱贫困。

words.example_en: His dream of seawater rice finally became a reality.
words.example_cn: 他的海水稻梦想终于变成了现实。

words.example_en: Even in his later years he was still full of vision.
words.example_cn: 即使在晚年,他仍然充满远见。

words.example_en: Long ago he envisioned rice plants as tall as sorghum.
words.example_cn: 很久以前他就想象稻株能长得像高粱一样高。

words.example_en: He could have retired to a life of leisure, but he did not.
words.example_cn: 他本可以退休去过悠闲的生活,但他没有。

words.example_en: An old shelter in London was turned into an urban farm.
words.example_cn: 伦敦一处旧防空洞被改造成了城市农场。

words.meaning_cn: 分布广的;普遍的;广泛的
words.example_en: Chemical pesticides have been in widespread use since the 1950s.
words.example_cn: 自20世纪50年代以来,化学杀虫剂已被广泛使用。

words.meaning_cn: 深(度);向下(或向里)的距离
words.example_en: Diverse crops use different depths of the soil.
words.example_cn: 多样的作物会利用不同深度的土壤。

words.example_en: His hybrid strains feed people both at home and abroad.
words.example_cn: 他的杂交品种养活了国内外的人们。

words.example_en: Few people want to stop using chemicals entirely.
words.example_cn: 很少有人想完全停止使用化学品。

words.example_en: For instance, peanuts grow on the ground's surface.
words.example_cn: 例如,花生长在地面上。
